title: THUNDER AND GLORY (1997) Production Budget & Shooting Schedule Packet - Rare
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Vintage Sports Memorabilia:Schedules
descriptionText:
This listing is for an original production budgeting and scheduling packet for the film project titled “THUNDER AND GLORY”, written by Dave Cass. These documents are dated September 1997 and outline detailed production planning including:
• Full line-item production budget
• Shooting day breakdowns
• Location notes
• Crew & equipment costs
• Extras & cast scheduling
• Vehicle and special effects planning
• Script and clearance logistics
This is a working pre-production set, marked “DRAFT” across pages, and includes dozens of sheets of internal planning material used to estimate the film’s total production cost (listed at approx. $2.95M according to the budget summary page).
This packet provides a rare look into behind-the-scenes production planning for an independent motion picture in the late 1990s. Documents like these typically circulated only among producers, unit production managers, accountants, and department heads.
Item Features
Title: THUNDER AND GLORY
Writer: Dave Cass
Date: September 1997
Pages: Multiple (full packet)
Sections include:
Above-the-Line & Below-the-Line cost breakdowns
Transportation & vehicle rental logs
Special effects cost estimates
Wardrobe, makeup, props, and location planning
Shooting schedule with scene-by-scene cast & equipment needs
A fascinating piece for:
Film history collectors
Screenwriters and filmmakers studying production planning
Fans of independent cinema
Production design researchers
Condition
Good vintage condition. Pages show light handling wear and occasional highlighting, consistent with production office use. No missing major sections. Clean and legible.
Please review photos for condition details.
